Done. This question exposed a genuinely distinct third variant in the savings-bond redemptions family, so I:

1. Created skill `officeqa-savings-bond-series-share-of-redemptions` — covers the "share of total redemptions accounted for by ONE named series (Series I/EE/HH), change in percentage points between two months, plus absolute change in that series' redemptions" pattern. Captured the key traps: denominator is total redemptions all-series (not outstanding, not sales), first value is percentage POINTS (share2−share1, not relative), second value is a raw $-millions difference of the series line. Verified example [7.1, 82] matched gold.

2. Patched the existing accrued-discount skill to cross-reference all three siblings so a future agent disambiguates correctly.

No memory update needed — the per-question facts (table location, the [7.1,82] answer) belong in the skill, not durable cross-session memory, and my format/rounding conventions are already covered.
